questions_and_answers.question_text: Arrange the following sentences in the right order for conversation: A: 7,800-en desu. / B: Kore desu ka? Doozo. / C: Sono akai seetaa o misete kudasai. / D: Jaa, kore o kudasai. / E: Ikura desu ka?

answers.answer_text: C, B, E, A, D (C: Sono akai seetaa o misete kudasai. / B: Kore desu ka? Doozo. / E: Ikura desu ka? / A: 7,800-en desu. / D: Jaa, kore o kudasai.)
